selection.rule: seeds ranked by the study's 36-episode reliability eval of the best snapshot (lapped fraction, then mean lap); the top 3 re-evaluated on 72 fresh distinct greedy episodes (env seed 31000) and the driver chosen by that result (tracks lapped in >= 90% of the episodes over the bundled and 10 generated tracks (trackgen seeds 100-109, difficulty 0.65, 12 episodes each), then lapped fraction on both); the fresh numbers are the ones recorded (they also picked among the 3 candidates, so a small selection effect remains in them)

seed_spread.interval: 95% percentile bootstrap of the IQM over seeds, 2000 resamples, RNG seed 0
